thread:
anya: heads-up — i pulled together a compact follow-up from yesterday's PM about the recurring KV OOMs. we need owners for the remaining remediation tasks and a short timeline.

mike: +1. i can take the profiling + heatmap work this sprint. want to confirm scope: heap growth vs fragmentation attribution?

anya: yes — split into two buckets: 1) native allocations that never free (leak) and 2) steady growth due to fragmentation/slab packing. mike = leak profiling; sophia = fragmentation GC/eviction tuning.

sophia: ok i'll own GC/eviction tuning. plan: run our fragmentation synth workload, collect per-shard residency and slab histograms, try enabling jemalloc background thread on a canary pool. target: hypothesis test + rollback plan by Thu EOD.

ryan: infra-bot triggered reminder — we've seen similar pattern on 3 clusters (eu-prod, us-west-2, canary-2) over 6 weeks. rolling charts attached in the PM. repeating pattern: small steady ramp until OOM at ~72h.

julia: for mitigation — can we add a soft memory cap per shard + prioritized eviction to avoid hard OOMs? i sketched a config: `shard.max_mem_percent=0.75` + `evict.prio=age` and a grace headroom of 10%.

mike: good idea. i'll also add lightweight alloc tracing on the canary (sample 1:1000) so we can find hot paths. command i'll run: ```LD_PRELOAD=/opt/debug/liballoctrace.so \nREDWOOD_PROFILE=sample:1000 ./runtime --shard=canary-2```

anya: please include the pprof flamegraphs in the followup doc. mike — estimate ETA?

mike: profiling + initial flamegraphs by Wed AM. deep root-cause before EOW if it's a single-code-path leak. if not, we escalate to a deeper heap-scan.

sophia: for fragmentation experiments i'll run two variants: (A) jemalloc background thread + aggressive decay, (B) enable slab compaction after idleness. metric goals: 30% reduction in resident growth slope and >95% avoidance of OOM in 7d runs.

julia: can we also add an emergency autoscale throttle that triggers earlier to avoid cascading failures? config prototype: `autoscale.surge_buffer=1.2` plus a rollback window. i can test on staging.

ryan: logging/alerts — SRE: change alert to warn at 60% of per-node OOM threshold and create a derived metric `kv_mem.leak_slope_6h`. we'd like to detect anomalies earlier.

anya: action items (quick):
- mike: profiling + flamegraphs (due Wed AM)
- sophia: fragmentation experiments + canary results (due Thu EOD)
- julia: soft-cap + autoscale throttle prototype on staging (due Fri)
- ryan: alert rule + dashboard panels (due Tue)
- anya: consolidate results + schedule postmortem followup (due next Mon)

mike: noted. i'll push raw traces to the shared bucket: `s3://redwood-eng/kvcache/profiles/2187654321` and post links here.

sophia: also adding a short-term runtime guard: `kv.evict_on_high_alloc=true` — flip on for dedicated pools until the canary proves safe. tagged owners so we can revert.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled to canary-2 at 2026-03-25T03:30Z. auto-rollback threshold: resident > 85% for 15m.

julia: small note — re: test harness: to reproduce fragmentation i used this pattern: `for i in 1..1000 spawn small writes then free large blocks randomly` — will share the exact harness in the doc.

anya: thanks everyone. let's keep replies here limited to status updates so i can collate into the follow-up doc. please ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:

mike: status: started profiling, pushed initial flamegraph link to the bucket (will post link here in-thread once uploaded).

sophia: status: running variant A on canary-2 now, ETA 18h for meaningful signal.

ryan: status: alert rule draft created, adding panels to the SLO dashboard.

julia: status: staging autoscale prototype deployed, smoke tests green. will schedule load run tomorrow.

anya: closing interim note — i'll assemble a one-pager and assign follow-ups in the PM tracker. next sync Thu 11:00 if anyone wants to join the quick triage.
